title: Portal refresh: three directions
question: The owner says the portal feels stale, dark and a bit pointless. Which direction should the production restyle of web/ follow? Each direction shows the agent conversation and New conversation (composer centred, repository, model and effort pickers in the composer control row) at 1600x1000.

options.label: A · Daylight briefing
options.thesis: A briefing you read on return: warm paper, Fraunces task titles, prose replies, tool work folded into structured result blocks, a Now card at the live edge, and Needs you as action cards.

options.label: B · Live fleet
options.thesis: An instrument panel that moves: fleet strip with host slot grids, sparklines and live tool calls on every lead row, a Now panel with elapsed time and CI stages, and a seconds-precision timeline.

options.label: C · Task desk
options.thesis: The task is the unit: an ink rail sorted into Needs you, In flight and To land (with Land and Prune), a light desk with a task card and todo stepper, the conversation beside an Outcome column, and a repository board under the New task composer.
